responsibility: Defines the generic printing interface for type-system entities, default path-printing logic for defs and impls, and shared helpers for describing modules and shortening long printed instance names.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `ty/mod.rs`, which is the full type-system root, this `mod.rs` is only the abstraction layer for rendering `ty` entities: it defines the generic `Print`/`Printer` traits and default def-path/impl-path formatting logic that the concrete pretty-printer module builds on.
